sv.title: Skickade hundratals meddelanden till AI innan dödskraschen
sv.summary: I mitten av september gav sig mannen ut på en vansinnesfärd i centrala Stockholm. Han kraschade i hög hastighet våldsamt in i en bil, som slungades vidare in i flera andra fordon. 57-åriga Lotta Hellstrand satt i den påkörda bilen och dog av sina skador. Hennes son skadades allvarligt.

en.title: Sent hundreds of messages to AI before the fatal crash
en.summary: In mid-September the man set off on a reckless drive in central Stockholm. He crashed violently at high speed into a car, which was sent on into several other vehicles. 57-year-old Lotta Hellstrand was sitting in the hit car and died of her injuries. Her son was seriously injured.
